prompt:
The section sections/rich-text-block.liquid renders its blocks naively: every heading becomes an h2, a text block becomes one paragraph, every button is printed even when empty, and the wrapper is printed whenever blocks exist. Rewrite the markup above the schema to the rules below. Keep the existing {% schema %}...{% endschema %} block byte-for-byte. Inputs (all supplied in every render): section.blocks, an array (possibly empty). Each block has block.type (string) and block.settings (object): - type "heading": settings.text (string or null), settings.level (integer or null). - type "text": settings.body (string or null; may contain newline characters). - type "button": settings.label (string or null), settings.url (string or null). - any other type: settings may be an empty object; such blocks render nothing and must not read any settings. All strings below are stripped of leading/trailing whitespace before use; null counts as empty. Rules (blocks processed in order): 1. Heading: rendered only if its stripped text is non-empty. Requested level R = level, or 2 if null; clamp R to the range 2..4. The effective level is the smaller of R and (P + 1), where P is the effective level of the previously rendered heading (P = 1 before any heading is rendered, so the first rendered heading is always h2). Output TEXT with E the effective level. Headings that are not rendered do not change P; text and button blocks do not change P. 2. Text: split body on newline characters; strip each line; each non-empty line becomes

LINE

in order. Empty lines produce nothing. 3. Button: rendered only if both stripped label and stripped url are non-empty: LABEL. 4. Button groups: every maximal run of rendered buttons that has no rendered heading or paragraph between them is wrapped in one
...
. Blocks that render nothing (including unknown types) do not break a run. A rendered heading or paragraph after a button closes the group before it is output; a group still open at the end is closed before the wrapper closes. 5. Wrapper: if at least one heading, paragraph or button is rendered, wrap everything in
...
; otherwise output nothing (empty string). 6. All text, labels and urls are HTML-escaped (after stripping). Output no whitespace or newlines between any tags. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Preserve the entire schema block byte-for-byte. Change only sections/rich-text-block.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
